answer: Umber sponsor-decay bond: a sponsor stakes a 70 umber bond for a newcomer and files a tundra survey. Each sponsorship decays reputation 10%, so the k-th costs 40+9(k-1) to sponsor. Auditors re-check 10% of surveys on the nebula board; a copied survey burns the bond. A rented-sponsor ring fails: spent reputation cannot be re-lent. 1,000 fakes cost 4,535,500 plus 70,000 locked vs 40,000 pool; an honest sponsor pays 40 once and keeps its bond.
